name: 🐟Ultimate Fishing Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Ultimate Fishing Simulator!

🎁 Use codes "WELCOME" and "GEMS" for rewards!

HOW TO PLAY:
🐟 Catch fish until your bucket is full
💰 Sell your fish to earn coins
🎣 Upgrade your rod
🎒 Buy new buckets to store more fish
🐠 Combine fish to make pets
💎 Use gems to upgrade your pets and rods
⛰️ Collect coins to unlock more areas

Made with ❤️ by Chefs Games
